observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Church hall or auditorium with a stage, pulpit, piano, and projector screen in the background
observation.formation_and_space: Initially in a diagonal line, then forming a curved line, shifting into pairs holding hands, and occasionally kneeling in groups
observation.posture: Upright torso, slightly bent knees, soft upright posture with gentle weight shifts
observation.footwork: Stepping side to side and forward on the beat, low to the ground in long skirts; fast footwork details cannot be clearly seen due to long skirts and resolution
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms held out to the sides or raised, hands making gentle gestures, sometimes holding hands in pairs or in a line
observation.hips_and_torso: Subtle torso sway and gentle hip movement accompanying the steps
observation.partnering: Holding hands in pairs and in a line, no weight-bearing partner lifts
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Transitions between standing and kneeling on the floor, no jumps or high turns
observation.costume_and_props: Colorful short-sleeved blouses and long patterned longyi (traditional Burmese skirts) worn by all dancers
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot placement and fast ankle actions are occluded by the long skirts and low video resolution.

signature_moments.what: Dancers sink down into a low kneeling position while extending arms outward
Dancers pair up and hold hands while facing each other and swaying
Line of dancers raises joined hands high overhead while stepping in place
